Auxiliary criterion explicitly revised after observation to independent barycentric Float64 error interval gamma8*(250+.5)+32eps64*251=0.00011944776687047794. Exact unique rounded bin outside interval; only admissible adjacent bins inside. Native-vs-allJulia GPU comparisons retain atol=rtol=0 and masks exact. Initial actualGPU reference mismatch4bytes caught despite ownPASS, then NVCC PTX contraction order aligned without changing native source.
